instruction: Follow up with Dana about the proposal if she hasn't replied.
final_text:
I sent Dana a follow-up about the proposal because she hadn't replied.

You emailed her the "Northwind proposal" on 23 Sep, and I found nothing from dana@pinecrest.example since then. My message went in that same email thread. It links the proposal again, asks if she's had a chance to look it over and offers to walk her team through it.

I didn't set a reminder to check for her reply. I can add one for later this week if you'd like.

input.subject: Re: Northwind proposal
input.body:
Hi Dana,

Just following up on the proposal I sent last week (https://docs.northwind.example/pinecrest-proposal). Have you had a chance to look it over? I'm happy to answer any questions or walk your team through it. Just let me know what time works.

Best,
Sam
